about.text: The Mongolian name (khoormog) for fermented camel's milk, left to sour naturally and made by camel-herding households, mostly in the Gobi, as airag is from mare's milk.

links.name: FAO, One Country One Priority Product: Mongolia

how.text: Mongolian khoormog is raw camel milk soured with leftover product. Lactobacillus dominates, chiefly L. kefiranofaciens, and yeasts give the drink a sour, slightly alcoholic taste.
